parameters.query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS capstone_employees (
    employee_id       SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name         VARCHAR(200)  NOT NULL,
    email             VARCHAR(255)  NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    department        VARCHAR(100)  NOT NULL,
    role              VARCHAR(100)  NOT NULL,
    approval_status   VARCHAR(30)   NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
    it_provisioned    BOOLEAN       NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    hr_payroll_setup  BOOLEAN       NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    created_at        TIMESTAMPTZ   NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at        TIMESTAMPTZ   NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_capstone_employees_email
    ON capstone_employees (email);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS capstone_onboarding_tasks (
    task_id       SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    employee_id   INTEGER      NOT NULL REFERENCES capstone_employees (employee_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    task_name     VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    status        VARCHAR(30)  NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
    created_at    TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_capstone_tasks_employee
    ON capstone_onboarding_tasks (employee_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS capstone_error_log (
    error_id        SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    workflow_name   VARCHAR(200),
    workflow_id     VARCHAR(100),
    execution_id    VARCHAR(100),
    node_name       VARCHAR(200),
    error_message   TEXT,
    stack_trace     TEXT,
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);
